description: Change one Pinterest product-group promotion — status (ACTIVE / PAUSED / ARCHIVED), bid, included, trackingUrl. Activating it, or moving its bid, under a LIVE campaign and ad group changes real spend and needs confirm:true. Read back from Pinterest. 0 credits.

included.description: false excludes the product group from the ad group
